slides.headline: Your boss asks you to lie.
Small one. Nobody gets hurt.
body: Everyone else has already said yes.

slides.headline: "You say no. I will not lie."
And they sack you.
body: He does not soften this part. He says it plainly, and then he says the next bit out loud too.
slides.kicker: "You wouldn't even have money to pay the school fees of your children."

slides.headline: That is the cost.
body: Not a hypothetical cost. A rent cost. A school-fees cost.
Anyone telling you obedience is free has not tried it.

slides.headline: So how do you know it was right?
body: You don't. Not while you're standing in it.

slides.headline: "It's only looking back that you will see God."
body: "Not when you're in that situation. In that situation, all you have to do is do what the King says."

slides.headline: Which is the hard part.
body: The clarity comes later. The decision comes now.
You act on who He is, not on what you can see.

slides.headline: You already know the answer.
body: You're just hoping there's a cheaper one.
slides.kicker: There usually isn't. And it is still worth it.
